notes.title: Release 1.2
notes.content:
Spellings over various names throughout the game have been changed to better reflect current lore.

Several dialogue sequences have been improved or altered.

New "concerned" art for Eleanora has been added.

Grinding the Simulation Room no longer places the player back on campus.
